hotels.title: Grand Re-Opening: Maldives Private Island Bliss with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Seaplane Transfers
hotels.description: Recently reopened after a six-month transformation, NH Collection Maldives Reethi Resort unveils a refreshed take on island paradise in the heart of the Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. This private-island retreat pairs powder-soft beaches and crystalline waters with beautifully upgraded villas, elevated dining venues and a vibrant house reef just offshore. Spend your days however you please: snorkelling straight from the beach, admiring manta rays at Hanifaru Bay or diving into the resort’s standout facilities. From water sports and scuba diving to the serene spa, adults-only pool and family-friendly offerings, there's something for everyone here. Seven bars and restaurants serve everything from bold Asian flavours and panoramic ocean vistas at Kaiyo, to Spanish tapas and cocktails at Atardecer. Handhuvaru rum bar offers creative drinks under the stars, while Alifaan delights with an openfire grill and a blend of European and Latin American dishes. Indulge all day long, then recline by the resort's breathtaking pool - with ocean views to match.
